projects.name: MNCDS
projects.responsibility: Independently versioned development-process specification for decomposition, candidate lifecycle, evidence flow, selection, release, and retirement.

projects.name: MNCS
projects.responsibility: Normative implementation-evidence standard: acceptance, evidence, status semantics, schemas, RFCs, and claim boundaries.

projects.name: MNCS Actions
projects.responsibility: Reusable GitHub Actions and family workflows for verification, evidence, provenance, coordination, and bounded aggregate checks, including the mncs-debug provider membrane.

projects.name: MNCS Atlas
projects.responsibility: Non-normative family orientation, ownership pointers, related-project discovery, compact navigation capsules, human presentation, and indexed decisions; Commons and owning repositories remain authoritative for architecture, pressure, and implementation facts.

projects.name: MNCS Atomic
projects.responsibility: Atomic-scale and classical particle simulation, spatial partitioning, neighbor lists, force accumulation, and deterministic parallelism pressure.

projects.name: MNCS Automation
projects.responsibility: Typed workflows, triggers, schedules, files, APIs, credentials, permissions, retries, and audit evidence.

projects.name: MNCS CLI
projects.responsibility: Typed command-line arguments, subcommands, help, completion, structured errors, and CLI ergonomics for MNCS applications.

projects.name: MNCS Commons
projects.responsibility: Durable structured knowledge exchange and shared work coordination. Pressure semantics remain Commons-owned and externally integrated.

projects.name: MNCS Compiler
projects.responsibility: MNCS-native next-generation compiler architecture and self-hosting pressure; the Stage-0 compiler remains in mncs-language.

projects.name: MNCS Control Systems
projects.responsibility: Deterministic real-time loops, state estimation, actuator/sensor boundaries, feedback control, and replayable control behavior.

projects.name: MNCS Control MCP
projects.responsibility: Protected workspace, Git, process, project, tooling, and bounded service adapters; it does not own Harness, Fabric, Commons, or conformance.

projects.name: MNCS Crypto
projects.responsibility: Established cryptographic primitives, published vectors, constant-time patterns, memory handling, and compiler/backend pressure for MNCS.

projects.name: MNCS Data
projects.responsibility: Schemas, tables, columns, missing values, Unicode, evolving data, streaming pipelines, and structured interchange pressure.

projects.name: MNCS Debug
projects.responsibility: Canonical structured debugger for witnesses, traces, inspection, provenance, replay guarantees, and capability truth; it consumes test evidence without redefining test semantics.

projects.name: MNCS Doc
projects.responsibility: Unicode-aware structured documents, source spans, syntax trees, transformations, formatting, layout, search, and interchange.

projects.name: MNCS Doctor
projects.responsibility: Repository discovery, health, repair, migration planning, transactional fixes, verification, and conformance bringing projects to current expectations.

projects.name: MNCS Engine
projects.responsibility: 2D/3D graphics, simulation, rendering, and heterogeneous compute pressure workloads across CPU, WASM, and accelerators.

projects.name: MNCS Fabric
projects.responsibility: Persistent exact-target execution, worker presence, transport, resource observations, retry/recovery, and execution evidence.

projects.name: MNCS FEM
projects.responsibility: Meshes, topology, fields, element assembly, material models, sparse solvers, and scientific verification pressure.

projects.name: MNCS Fluid
projects.responsibility: Fields, meshes, PDE discretization, stencil computation, iterative solvers, parallel reductions, and heterogeneous CFD workloads.

projects.name: MNCS Forge
projects.responsibility: Bounded development workflows, provider orchestration, evidence gaps, lineage, and evaluator-mode boundaries.

projects.name: MNCS Geometry
projects.responsibility: Geometric primitives, robust predicates, intersections, topology, spatial data structures, and coordinate systems.

projects.name: MNCS Harness
projects.responsibility: Deployment-specific model/tool routing, approvals, agent loops, acceptance, and escalation while consuming Fabric and Commons.

projects.name: MNCS Index
projects.responsibility: Deterministic incremental indexing, discovery, ranking, relation, traversal, and query over family artifacts and metadata.

projects.name: MNCS Ingest
projects.responsibility: External representation to canonical typed structures, relations, context, provenance, and graph-ready semantic fragments.

projects.name: MNCS Lab
projects.responsibility: REPL, JIT, persistent compiler sessions, incremental compilation, proof-aware execution, and interactive language pressure.

projects.name: MNCS Language
projects.responsibility: Verification-native language, compiler, semantic representation, standard library, effects, and backend contracts.

projects.name: MNCS Language Service
projects.responsibility: Resident LSP and MCP semantic tooling over mncs-language, including the shared source/debug identity projection; it does not own language or debugger semantics.

projects.name: MNCS Learn
projects.responsibility: Evidence-driven state transitions across heterogeneous micro-models, adaptive graphs, datasets, checkpoints, and training processes.

projects.name: MNCS Lineage
projects.responsibility: Successor synthesis, inheritance, promotion evidence, rollback, and controlled generational replacement research.

projects.name: MNCS Math
projects.responsibility: Exact and numerical scientific mathematics, linear algebra, tensors, intervals, autodiff, statistics, and numerical methods.

projects.name: MNCS Media
projects.responsibility: Image, audio, video, timing, metadata, binary I/O, streaming, and codec-boundary pressure workloads.

projects.name: MNCS Memory
projects.responsibility: Immutable observations, claims, contradiction and supersession state, retrieval, escalation, and compact answer capsules.

projects.name: MNCS Numerics
projects.responsibility: Reusable numerical primitives, reductions, guarded kernels, and algorithms written in MNCS while pressuring the language.

projects.name: MNCS Physics
projects.responsibility: Quantities, dimensions, units, constants, mechanics, rigid-body foundations, and scientific physical models.

projects.name: MNCS Reference Studies
projects.responsibility: Controlled empirical comparisons, reference reimplementations, reproducibility studies, and negative results.

projects.name: MNCS Rights & Provenance
projects.responsibility: Artifact origin, transformation lineage, contribution provenance, rights basis, licensing evidence, and legal uncertainty without manufacturing legal conclusions.

projects.name: MNCS Service
projects.responsibility: Long-running service lifecycle, bounded queues, workers, retries, framing, configuration, contracts, and observability.

projects.name: MNCS Signal
projects.responsibility: Sampled signals, timebases, complex arithmetic, FFT/IFFT, streaming, latency, and deterministic signal workloads.

projects.name: MNCS Store
projects.responsibility: Typed durable objects, identities, representations, generations, integrity, placement, provenance, and recovery.

projects.name: MNCS System Monitor
projects.responsibility: Bounded OS observation, process/resource relationships, interval-qualified metrics, and human/machine projections.

projects.name: MNCS Test
projects.responsibility: Canonical first-class MNCS test provider: compiler-owned inventory, selection, native oracle/suite semantics, TestResult and CheckResult evidence; it does not own execution transport or debugging semantics.

projects.name: MNCS TUI
projects.responsibility: Terminal UI layouts, structured rendering, widgets, interaction, geometry, and bounded terminal host realization.

projects.name: MNCS UI
projects.responsibility: Declarative components, layout, reactive state, events, accessibility, animation, and native rendering pressure.

projects.name: MNCS Rust Validator
projects.responsibility: Independent offline validation for supported MNCS subsets; it does not wrap the Python validator or execute evidence.

projects.name: MNCS Web
projects.responsibility: Typed HTTP and web-service structures, incremental protocol parsing, effects, and application-level web pressure workloads.

projects.name: MNCS Experimental Learning
projects.responsibility: Evidence-governed investigators, bounded interventions, causal attribution, negative memory, and verified-experience distillation.

projects.name: RAVEL
projects.responsibility: Evidence strategy, scoped memory, causal interpretation, and reusable learning beneath MNCS and MNCDS authority.

decisions.title: Family automation transports evidence without owning claim semantics
decisions.summary: Reusable actions validate and transport bounded results; owning standards, validators, and providers retain semantic authority.

decisions.title: Atlas is the family orientation and ownership map
decisions.summary: Atlas records orientation-level project, ownership, relationship, and decision pointers while preserving Commons, owning repositories, Doctor, Forge, Harness, and language boundaries.

decisions.title: Micro-model MCP control is an additive bounded policy layer
decisions.summary: Small task-specific models may reduce tool-catalog cost, but deterministic Control/Harness boundaries retain authority.

decisions.title: Cryptographic workloads are pressure evidence, not cryptographic authority
decisions.summary: Established algorithms and vectors pressure MNCS exactness and backend guarantees without turning the pressure laboratory into a security certifier.

decisions.title: Repository migration belongs to mncs-doctor
decisions.summary: The language owns syntax and migration knowledge; Doctor owns repository discovery, planning, transactions, repair orchestration, and reporting.

decisions.title: Deployment routing and acceptance stay in Harness
decisions.summary: Harness chooses deployment routing and acceptance; Fabric owns execution and Commons owns durable records.

decisions.title: Indexes are derived discovery and traversal structures
decisions.summary: Indexing owns finding, ranking, relating, and traversing state without becoming canonical storage, semantic authority, or authoritative family preflight.

decisions.title: Ingest normalizes external observations without owning memory
decisions.summary: Ingest produces canonical semantic fragments with provenance; retention and reasoning remain downstream responsibilities.

decisions.title: Explicit type and semantic architecture for MNCS Language
decisions.summary: Explicit type, generic, interface, and evidence semantics keep the AST, compiler, and backend boundaries inspectable and deterministic.

decisions.title: Pressure-driven source-profile evolution
decisions.summary: Language profiles evolve through explicit pressure, bounded semantics, executable regressions, and documented compatibility rather than silent widening.

decisions.title: Numerics owns reusable numeric primitives and algorithms
decisions.summary: Foundational numeric behavior should be implemented once in the numerics layer and consumed by scientific and application projects.

decisions.title: Storage owns durable identity and representation
decisions.summary: Committed content, logical identity, representations, provenance, placement, durability, and recovery remain storage-owned invariants.
